verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs describe continuous queries as SQL statements that run continuously, analyze incoming data in real time, and write or export their output rows to destinations. Dataform adds declarative, scheduled ELT transformation workflows in BigQuery, with dependency graphs and quality tests, and release notes add Git-managed pipelines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of continuous queries in production, explicit evidence of incremental (delta-only) processing semantics, and the full list of continuous-query output destinations.
